name: Concie Chat
author: concie

sections.description:
Concie is an AI agent that talks to your customers 24/7 — answering product questions, recommending items, and helping shoppers check out. Once connected, this plugin loads the Concie chat widget on every page of your storefront. No theme edits, no copy-pasting embed codes.

You need a Concie account and an Agent. Create one free at https://concie.co.

External services

This plugin connects to Concie, a third-party AI chat service, to provide the storefront widget. This is required for the plugin to function.

  • It loads the widget loader script from the Concie host (default https://shop-main.up.railway.app/loader/), which in turn loads the chat widget. This happens in your visitors’ browsers on storefront pages.
  • On activation and whenever you save the settings, it sends your site URL, your Agent ID, and the plugin version to https://app.concie.co/api/woo/connected so your Concie dashboard can mark the channel as live.
  • Clicking “Connect to Concie” opens https://app.concie.co/welcome/woo with your site URL, your WordPress admin email (to pre-fill your Concie account), and a one-time pairing code. This site then accepts a single automatic write-back of the resulting Agent ID at /wp-json/concie/v1/pair, authenticated by that same code — the code expires after 30 minutes or first use.

Concie terms: https://www.concie.co/terms — Concie privacy policy: https://www.concie.co/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress Admin, go to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin, choose the Concie Chat .zip, then Install Now -> Activate.
  2. Go to Settings -> Concie and click “Connect to Concie”.
  3. Finish the short setup wizard in the tab that opens. Your agent is created and connected back to this site automatically — no Agent ID to copy or paste.
  4. The widget appears on your storefront immediately.

If you downloaded the plugin directly from your Concie dashboard, the Agent ID is already filled in — just activate.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Concie account?

Yes. The widget is powered by your Concie agent. Sign up free at https://concie.co.

Where do I find my Agent ID?

You don’t need to — “Connect to Concie” creates and links your agent automatically. It’s still visible (and pasteable, if you ever need to link a different agent) under Settings -> Concie -> Advanced.

How do I remove the widget?

Deactivate the plugin, or clear the Agent ID field under Settings -> Concie.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • “Connect to Concie” now creates and links your agent automatically — no Agent ID to copy or paste.
  • Added a one-time pairing code (30-min expiry, single use) and a /wp-json/concie/v1/pair endpoint so Concie can write the Agent ID back to this site.
  • Connect link now pre-fills your Concie account email from your WordPress admin email.
  • Manual Agent ID entry moved under an “Advanced” section on the settings page.
  • Notes when WooCommerce isn’t active — the widget still works, but product-specific answers need it.

1.2.0

  • Declared WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables) and Cart/Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • Marketplace + WordPress.org readiness.

1.1.0

  • Generic, marketplace-ready build: one plugin for everyone, connect via Settings -> Concie.
  • Added connection status, “Connect to Concie” action, and an external-services disclosure.
  • Widget script now only loads once an Agent ID is configured.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
